title: 20-Minute HIIT Elliptical Fat-Burn Protocol
description: Short, explosive sprint intervals designed to maximize EPOC caloric afterburn without joint impact.

recommendedMachine.name: Sole Fitness E25 Elliptical
recommendedMachine.tagline: Heavy 20 lb flywheel prevents pedal slip during max-effort sprints.

intervals.name: Warmup
intervals.notes: Easy cadence to elevate core temperature.

intervals.name: Sprint 1
intervals.notes: All-out sprint effort. Push and pull handles.

intervals.name: Recovery 1
intervals.notes: Deep nasal breathing, steady pace.

intervals.name: Sprint 2
intervals.notes: Drive through the heels.

intervals.name: Recovery 2
intervals.notes: Active recovery.

intervals.name: Sprint 3
intervals.notes: High resistance sprint.

intervals.name: Recovery 3
intervals.notes: Control your heart rate.

intervals.name: Sprint 4
intervals.notes: Explosive upper and lower body drive.

intervals.name: Recovery 4
intervals.notes: Shake out grip tension, maintain smooth stride.

intervals.name: Sprint 5
intervals.notes: Hold 85 RPM against heavy resistance.

intervals.name: Recovery 5
intervals.notes: Controlled exhale on every second stride.

intervals.name: Sprint 6
intervals.notes: Penultimate power interval. Stay tall.

intervals.name: Recovery 6
intervals.notes: Prepare mentally for the final sprint.

intervals.name: Sprint 7
intervals.notes: Final max-effort burst. Empty the tank.

intervals.name: Cooldown
intervals.notes: Flush lactic acid, slow controlled strides.

title: 30-Minute Low-Impact Knee-Friendly Stride Routine
description: Zero-impact gliding workout engineered for individuals managing knee sensitivity or recovering from joint strain.

recommendedMachine.name: Horizon Fitness 7.0 AE
recommendedMachine.tagline: Ergonomic 20-inch stride length minimizes knee flexion angles.

intervals.name: Gentle Warmup
intervals.notes: Smooth continuous gliding. Keep heels planted on pedals.

intervals.name: Steady Cruise 1
intervals.notes: Zone 2 conversational pace.

intervals.name: Reverse Stride
intervals.notes: Pedal backwards to activate hamstrings and balance quad pressure.

intervals.name: Steady Cruise 2
intervals.notes: Slight resistance increase, keep posture tall.

intervals.name: Cooldown Glides
intervals.notes: Full gentle recovery.

title: 45-Minute Pyramid Glute & Posterior Chain Climb
description: Progressive incline and high-resistance pyramid workout designed to target the glutes, hamstrings, and calves without spinal compression.

recommendedMachine.name: NordicTrack AirGlide 14i
recommendedMachine.tagline: Up to 15% power ramp incline and -5% decline for maximum posterior chain recruitment.

intervals.name: Dynamic Glute Warmup
intervals.notes: Sit slightly back into your hips and press through full heel contact.

intervals.name: Base Hill Climb
intervals.notes: Establish rhythmic breathing. Light grip on stationary handlebars.

intervals.name: Steepening Grade
intervals.notes: Hinge 10 degrees forward from the hips to load the glute max.

intervals.name: Ridge Push
intervals.notes: Heavy muscular tension. Avoid bouncing the knees.

intervals.name: Summit Peak Overload
intervals.notes: Maximum incline and resistance. Slow, deliberate power strokes.

intervals.name: Reverse Glute Isolation
intervals.notes: Pedal in reverse while keeping hips low for deep glute burn.

intervals.name: Descending Ridge
intervals.notes: Switch back to forward stride, increase RPM as resistance drops.

intervals.name: Base Tempo Flush
intervals.notes: Engage moving arms to boost total-body oxygen uptake.

intervals.name: Cooldown & Hip Stretch Stride
intervals.notes: Lengthen stride and allow heart rate to drop below 110 BPM.

title: 15-Minute Express Morning Fat-Shred Routine
description: Time-crunched metabolic ignition workout combining brisk 60-second cadence surges with active recovery.

recommendedMachine.name: Schwinn 470 Elliptical
recommendedMachine.tagline: Quick-select Goal Track console keys let you jump resistance levels in one tap.

intervals.name: Quick Ignition Warmup
intervals.notes: Brisk arm swing to wake up upper and lower body.

intervals.name: Brisk Surge 1
intervals.notes: Pick up cadence to 70 RPM. Smooth circular foot motion.

intervals.name: Steady Recovery 1
intervals.notes: Catch your breath while keeping pedals moving.

intervals.name: Brisk Surge 2
intervals.notes: Pull back firmly on the moving handles.

intervals.name: Steady Recovery 2
intervals.notes: Relax shoulders away from ears.

intervals.name: Brisk Surge 3
intervals.notes: Slight resistance bump—keep RPM above 70.

intervals.name: Steady Recovery 3
intervals.notes: Steady rhythmic breathing.

intervals.name: Brisk Surge 4
intervals.notes: Fastest turnover of the routine.

intervals.name: Steady Recovery 4
intervals.notes: Prepare for the 2-minute closing push.

intervals.name: Final Power Push
intervals.notes: Sustained strong effort for two full minutes.

intervals.name: Express Cooldown
intervals.notes: Gradually slow down until breathing is effortless.

title: 20-Minute Beginner Aerobic Foundation Stride
description: Approachable, rhythm-focused cardiovascular routine designed to build stamina and confidence without breathless spikes.

recommendedMachine.name: Sunny Health & Fitness SF-E3912
recommendedMachine.tagline: Compact electromagnetic frame ideal for home cardio rooms and daily Zone 2 sessions.

intervals.name: Easy Mobility Warmup
intervals.notes: Focus on upright posture and flat foot contact.

intervals.name: Aerobic Base Stride 1
intervals.notes: Maintain a pace where you can speak in full sentences.

intervals.name: Posture & Arm-Drive Focus
intervals.notes: Let upper-body push/pull share 40% of the workload.

intervals.name: Aerobic Base Stride 2
intervals.notes: Smooth, quiet pedal strokes with engaged core.

intervals.name: Gentle Cooldown
intervals.notes: Easy recovery stride to bring heart rate back to baseline.

title: 30-Minute Tabata VO2 Max & Afterburn Conditioner
description: High-intensity anaerobic conditioning featuring three dense Tabata work blocks to push VO2 max and metabolic rate.

recommendedMachine.name: Sole Fitness E35 Elliptical
recommendedMachine.tagline: Commercial-grade 25 lb flywheel and dual-track rails lock in stability at 90+ RPM.

intervals.name: Progressive Warmup
intervals.notes: Gradually increase RPM from 50 to 60 over 4 minutes.

intervals.name: Primer Surge
intervals.notes: Open up the lungs before high-output Tabata blocks.

intervals.name: Tabata Block 1 (Max Output)
intervals.notes: Alternate 20s all-out sprint (85+ RPM) with 10s easy coasting for 8 rounds.

intervals.name: Active Recovery Stride 1
intervals.notes: Slow cadence, focus on deep diaphragmatic recovery breaths.

intervals.name: Tabata Block 2 (High Incline)
intervals.notes: Alternate 20s steep power drive with 10s slow pedal turnover.

intervals.name: Active Recovery Stride 2
intervals.notes: Sip water and reset shoulder posture.

intervals.name: Tabata Block 3 (Final Finisher)
intervals.notes: Final 4-minute Tabata block—give every 20s work bout 100% effort.

intervals.name: Extended Lactic Flush Cooldown
intervals.notes: 6 full minutes of easy spinning to clear lactate safely.

title: 30-Minute Reverse-Stride & Core Balance Sculpt
description: Alternating forward, reverse, and hands-free balance intervals that challenge core stabilizers while toning quads and hamstrings evenly.

recommendedMachine.name: Bowflex Max Total 16
recommendedMachine.tagline: Multi-grip dynamic handles and stable frame geometry support forward and reverse interval transitions.

intervals.name: Forward Glide Warmup
intervals.notes: Find your center of gravity over the foot pedals.

intervals.name: No-Hands Core Balance Forward
intervals.notes: Place hands on hips or pump arms like a runner—brace abs tightly.

intervals.name: Reverse Hamstring & Glute Drive 1
intervals.notes: Pedal backwards with light grip on stationary center bar.

intervals.name: Upper-Body Push/Pull Tempo
intervals.notes: Forward stride—exaggerate chest push and back row on moving handles.

intervals.name: Reverse Hamstring & Glute Drive 2
intervals.notes: Drop hips 2 inches lower while pedaling in reverse.

intervals.name: Core Stability Finisher
intervals.notes: Hands-free brisk forward stride with tall spine.

intervals.name: Slow Forward Cooldown
intervals.notes: Easy recovery stride and gentle torso rotation.

title: 45-Minute Zone 2 Mitochondrial Endurance Builder
description: Sustained aerobic base-building protocol targeting 65-75% max heart rate to maximize fat oxidation and cardiovascular longevity.

recommendedMachine.name: ProForm Pro HIIT H14
recommendedMachine.tagline: Silent Magnetic Resistance (SMR) and oversized cushioned pedals keep 45-minute endurance sessions whisper-quiet.

intervals.name: Gradual Aerobic Warmup
intervals.notes: Ease into rhythm with nasal-only breathing.

intervals.name: Zone 2 Cruise Block 1
intervals.notes: Lock into 60 RPM. Heart rate should stay in conversational Zone 2.

intervals.name: Cadence Pick-Up & Reverse Flush
intervals.notes: Pedal backwards for the middle 2 minutes to prevent foot numbness.

intervals.name: Zone 2 Cruise Block 2 (Mild Incline)
intervals.notes: Steady rolling hill effort. Keep shoulders relaxed.

intervals.name: Cadence Pick-Up & Posture Check
intervals.notes: Hydrate and maintain crisp 64 RPM cadence.

intervals.name: Zone 2 Steady Finisher
intervals.notes: Hold steady aerobic output without drifting into Zone 3.

intervals.name: Parasympathetic Cooldown
intervals.notes: Long slow exhales to kickstart post-workout recovery.
